items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: That's little Henry Rust, they call him. That's one of the bass players that used to play in the Navy band.

ctx.x: This bass player, who's he again?
That's little Henry Rust, they call him. That's one of the bass players that used to play in the Navy band.
And the second trumpet, of course, isn't with the band.
